message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: build and deploy

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      update:
        description: "build + deploy"
        required: true
        default: "Build & Deploy"

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    if: ${{ contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'version:') || contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[build]') }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18

      - name: Cache npm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-node-

      - name: Build distributable
        run: |
          npm ci
          ls -al
          npm run build

      - name: Upload Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-artifact
          path: ./dist

  deploy:
    needs: build
    if: ${{ contains(github.ref, 'main') || contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[deploy]') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download Build Artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-artifact
          path: dist

      - name: Zip files
        run: zip -r dist.zip ./dist/*

      - name: Install chrome-webstore-upload-cli
        run: npm install -g chrome-webstore-upload-cli

      - name: Upload extension to Chrome Web Store
        run: >
          npx chrome-webstore-upload-cli upload
          --extension-id ${{ secrets.EXTENSION_ID }}
          --client-id ${{ secrets.CLIENT_ID }}
          --client-secret ${{ secrets.CLIENT_SECRET }}
          --refresh-token ${{ secrets.REFRESH_TOKEN }}
          --source dist
",
  "rationale": "Two evidence-supported optimizations are applied: (1) Cache npm dependencies using actions/cache keyed on package-lock.json to avoid repeated downloads on each build run, supported by pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE which reports modest but measurable VM time reductions (6% free, 3.4% paid). (2) Add explicit job timeouts (10 minutes for build, 5 minutes for deploy) to bound runaway executions, supported by pattern P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT and experimental evidence showing ~27% elapsed time savings with a 5-minute timeout on a similar Node.js workflow. Both changes preserve all existing build/test coverage and deployment behavior, and introduce no new permissions or network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}
